mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_graph_ingest (dataset_id, ingested_at, schema_version_at_ingest, chunk_count, node_count, edge_count, extraction_failures, status) VALUES (#{datasetId}, , #{schemaVersionAtIngest}, #{chunkCount}, #{nodeCount}, #{edgeCount}, #{extractionFailures}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.dataset_id, g.ingested_at, g.schema_version_at_ingest, g.chunk_count, g.node_count, g.edge_count, g.extraction_failures, g.status FROM dataset_graph_ingest g WHERE g.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY g.ingested_at DESC, g.id DESC

SELECT latest.dataset_id, latest.ingested_at, latest.schema_version_at_ingest, o.schema_version AS ontology_version FROM (SELECT g.dataset_id, g.ingested_at, g.schema_version_at_ingest, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.dataset_id ORDER BY g.ingested_at DESC, g.id DESC) AS rn FROM dataset_graph_ingest g) latest JOIN dataset_ontology dn ON dn.dataset_id = latest.dataset_id JOIN ontology o ON o.id = dn.ontology_id WHERE latest.rn = 1 AND latest.schema_version_at_ingest < o.schema_version AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dataset WHERE dataset.id = latest.dataset_id AND NOT
